sql: SELECT Timestamp AS ts, Body AS body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= '2026-10-27 02:00:00' AND Timestamp < '2026-10-27 08:00:00' AND ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-pbt-1' AND ResourceAttributes['host.name']='lighthouse-besu-1' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name']='execution' AND NOT match(Body, 'Submitted transaction|Served eth_sendRawTransaction|eth_sendRawTransaction|eth_getTransactionCount|Looking for peers|Announced transaction|already known|nonce too high|Error response handling JsonRpc') ORDER BY Timestamp
